children: A drone incident prompted a temporary suspension of loading operations at the Caspian Pipeline Consortium's (CPC) Black Sea terminal, Kazakhstan's Energy Ministry said on Wednesday.
Loading was temporarily halted at Single Point Moorings (SPM) 2 and 3 following the incident, but operations later resumed.
